race.comment: RAGING RAIDER (10) just ran into one better at Doomben last time out and looks to be building up to a maiden victory. Has placed around this circuit and looks the one they all have to run down. WINNING HARLOW (11) has just missed the placings in both career outings to date and looks ready for the step-up in trip now. Respect from the Lees barn. HIT A LICK (8) put in a career-best performance at the latest effort and will be ready to peak third-up from the break. Shapes as a leading contender. PIROUETTE GIRL (9) placed over this distance range last start and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside marble. Top-three candidate. TED LASSO (6) best of the rest with Melbourne Cup winning rider Dolan in the saddle.
